```{r setup, include=FALSE}

# set up output html figures to be in SVG format
# set up current working directory to be the project directory
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE,dev='svg',root.dir = rprojroot::find_rstudio_root_file())
date.stamp <- format(Sys.Date(),format="%d%b%Y")
print(rprojroot::find_rstudio_root_file())
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir=rprojroot::find_rstudio_root_file())

# THIS NEEDS TO BE EDITED
this.analysis <- "UGCG_BETA_analyses"

# output files will be prefixed with this.analysis and placed in the "out" folder
filestamp <- function(x) {
  paste0('out/',this.analysis,"_",xfun::sans_ext(x),"_", format(Sys.Date(),format="%d%b%Y"), ".",xfun::file_ext(x))
}

# Functions to get date and time
getDate <- function() format(Sys.Date(), "%Y%m%d")
getTime <- function() format(Sys.time(), "%H:%M:%S")

# copy snapshot of this Rmd to output folder
this.rmd <- knitr::current_input()
if(!is.null(this.rmd)) {
system(paste0("cp src/",
              this.rmd,
              " ",
              paste0("out/",xfun::sans_ext(this.rmd),'_',format(Sys.Date(),format="%d%b%Y"),".",xfun::file_ext(this.rmd))
)
)
}

# Define project I/O directory structure
projDir <- "~/Projects/UGCG_BETA" # needs to be edited
dataDir <- file.path(projDir, "data")
outDir <- file.path(projDir, "out", this.analysis, getDate())

depmapDir <- file.path(dataDir, "DMC_26Q1")
toilDir <- file.path(dataDir, "TCGA_TARGET_GTEx")

if(!dir.exists(outDir)) dir.create(outDir, recursive = TRUE)

options(tidyverse.quiet = TRUE)
Sys.setenv("VROOM_CONNECTION_SIZE" = 1000000)

```

## Load libraries

```{r}

library(tidyverse)
library(magrittr)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(ggsci)
library(viridis)
library(conflicted)

conflict_prefer_all("dplyr", quiet = TRUE)

```

## Load data

```{r}

# Mount GCP buckets
if(length(list.files(depmapDir)) == 0) system("axe-cloud-fuser mount --path buckets.yaml")

## DepMap DMC 26Q1 ##

# Metadata
depmap_mtdt <- read_csv(file.path(depmapDir, "Model.csv"))

# Expression
depmap_exp_file <- file.path(depmapDir, "OmicsExpressionTPMLogp1HumanProteinCodingGenes.csv")
depmap_exp_outfile <- file.path(dataDir, "UGCG_DMC_26Q1_log2TPM.txt")

if(!file.exists(depmap_exp_outfile))
{
  depmap_exp <- read_csv(depmap_exp_file, n_max = 10)
  
  # Define genes of interest
  GOI <- c("UGCG")
  
  # Extract columns of interest
  COI <- c(grep("ModelID", colnames(depmap_exp)),
           grep("IsDefaultEntryForModel", colnames(depmap_exp)),
           grep(paste(unique(GOI), collapse = "|"), colnames(depmap_exp)))
  
  # Expression filtered for genes of interest
  depmap_exp <- read_csv(pipe(paste0("cut -d',' -f", paste(COI, collapse = ","), " ", depmap_exp_file))) %>%
                filter(IsDefaultEntryForModel == "Yes") %>%
                select(-IsDefaultEntryForModel) %>%
                pivot_longer(cols = !ModelID, names_to = "GeneSymbol", values_to = "log2TPM") %>%
                mutate(GeneSymbol = str_extract(GeneSymbol, "[^ ]+")) %>%
                filter(GeneSymbol %in% GOI) %>%
                left_join(select(depmap_mtdt, ModelID, grep("Oncotree", names(depmap_mtdt))), by = "ModelID")
  
  write_tsv(depmap_exp, depmap_exp_outfile)
} else {
  depmap_exp <- read_tsv(depmap_exp_outfile) %>% as.data.frame()
}

## TCGA-TARGET-GTEx TOIL RNA-seq recompute from UCSC ##

toil_exp_file <- file.path(toilDir, "TcgaTargetGtex_rsem_gene_tpm.txt")
toil_exp_outfile <- file.path(dataDir, "UGCG_TCGA_TARGET_GTEx_log2TPM.txt")

# Metadata
toil_mtdt <- read_tsv(file.path(toilDir, "TcgaTargetGTEX_phenotype.txt")) %>% as.data.frame()
toil_annot <- read_tsv(file.path(toilDir, "TcgaTargetGtex_probeMap_gencode.v23.annotation.gene.probemap.txt")) %>% as.data.frame()

colnames(toil_mtdt) <- gsub("^_", "", colnames(toil_mtdt))

ugcg_id <- toil_annot$id[which(toil_annot$gene == "UGCG")]

if(!file.exists(toil_exp_outfile))
{
  toil_exp <- read_tsv(pipe(paste0("gawk 'BEGIN {FS=\"\\t\"} {if(NR == 1 || $1 == \"", ugcg_id, "\") {print $0}}' ", toil_exp_file))) %>%
              mutate(GeneSymbol = "UGCG") %>%
              select(GeneSymbol, names(.)) %>%
              select(-sample) %>%
              pivot_longer(cols = !GeneSymbol, names_to = "sample", values_to = "log2TPM") %>%
              left_join(toil_mtdt, by = "sample") %>%
              rename(SampleID = sample) %>%
              filter(!sample_type %in% c("Control Analyte", "Cell Line") & !grepl("treatment", sample_type)) %>%
              mutate(TPM = (2^log2TPM)-0.001,
                     log2TPM = log2(TPM + 1)) +
              mutate(sample_type = case_when(sample_type == "Solid Tissue Normal" ~ "Normal Tissue",
                                             grepl("Primary", sample_type) ~ "Primary Tumor",
                                             grepl("Metastatic", sample_type) ~ "Metastatic Tumor",
                                             grepl("Recurrent", sample_type) ~ "Recurrent Tumor",
                                             .default = sample_type),
                     sample_type = factor(sample_type, levels = c("Primary Tumor", "Recurrent Tumor", "Metastatic Tumor", "Normal Tissue")),
                     detailed_category = case_when(detailed_category == "Acute Myeloid Leukemia, Induction Failure Subproject" ~ "Acute Myeloid Leukemia",
                                                   .default = detailed_category),
                     primary_site = case_when(primary_site == "Adrenal gland" ~ "Adrenal Gland",
                                              primary_site == "Cervix Uteri" ~ "Cervix",
                                              primary_site == "Soft tissue,Bone" ~ "Soft Tissue: Bone",
                                              primary_site == "Sympathetic\xcaNervous System" ~ "Sympathetic Nervous System",
                                              primary_site == "Thyroid Gland" ~ "Thyroid",
                                              is.na(primary_site) & detailed_category == "Skin - Sun Exposed (Lower Leg)" ~ "Skin",
                                              is.na(primary_site) & detailed_category == "Esophagus - Mucosa" ~ "Esophagus",
                                              is.na(primary_site) & detailed_category == "Stomach" ~ "Stomach",
                                              .default = primary_site)) %>%
              as.data.frame()

} else {
  toil_exp <- read_tsv(toil_exp_outfile) %>% as.data.frame()
}

```

## Plot GTEx expression

```{r}

gtex <- toil_exp %>%
        filter(study == "GTEX")

gtex_med <- gtex %>%
            group_by(primary_site) %>%
            summarise(median_log2TPM = median(log2TPM, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
            ungroup() %>%
            arrange(median_log2TPM)

gtex %<>% mutate(primary_site = factor(primary_site, levels = gtex_med$primary_site))

gtex_bp <- gtex %>%
            ggplot(aes(primary_site, log2TPM)) +
            geom_jitter(aes(color = primary_site),
                       size = 0.25,
                       width = 0.2,
                       alpha = 0.6) +
            geom_boxplot(fill = "white",
                         alpha = 0.3,
                         width = 0.5,
                         outliers = FALSE) +
            scale_color_viridis(discrete = TRUE, direction = -1, option = "plasma") +
            coord_flip() +
            labs(y = "Log2(TPM + 1)") +
            theme_minimal() +
            theme(legend.position = "none",
                  axis.title.x = element_text(size = 8),
                  axis.text.x = element_text(size = 8),
                  axis.title.y = element_blank(),
                  axis.text.y = element_text(size = 7),
                  plot.margin = margin(5, 5, 5, 5, "mm"))

png(file.path(outDir, "UGCG_GTEx_log2TPM_boxplots.png"), height = 4, width = 3.5, units = "in", res = 300)
print(gtex_bp)
dev.off()

```


# Plot primary site vs. sample type

```{r}

pd <- position_dodge2(width = 0.8, preserve = "single")
n_sites <- length(unique(toil_exp$primary_site))

ps_vs_st <- toil_exp %>%
            ggplot(aes(primary_site, log2TPM)) +
            geom_point(aes(color = primary_site),
                       size = 0.5,
                       alpha = 0.3) +
            geom_boxplot(fill = "white",
                         alpha = 0.3,
                         width = 0.5,
                         outliers = FALSE) +
            coord_flip() +
            facet_wrap(~study) +
            theme_bw() +
            theme(legend.position = "none")

```
